name: Govinda Lamsal
title: Cloud Solution Architect, Full-stack Developer & Cloud Trainer.
tagline: Turning ambitious ideas into scalable, data-driven digital solutions.
about: I design the cloud behind the product, build the experience in front of it, and help others understand how it all works.

As a Cloud Solution Architect at TekBay Academy, I bring together AWS cloud architecture, full-stack development and data science to create scalable, data-driven digital solutions with real-world impact.

My approach connects hands-on engineering with clear communication: translate a business need into an architecture, turn that architecture into a useful product, and make the knowledge accessible through practical cloud training.

projects.name: DCart
projects.description: An eCommerce platform connecting vendors, shoppers and platform administrators.
points: Built homepage and product/category experiences with responsive forms and product images.
Developed vendor and user dashboard features, reviews, vendor replies and advertisements.
Worked on eSewa and Khalti payments, order receipt PDFs, sales reporting and reward points.

projects.name: Three-tier AWS application
projects.description: A practical AWS architecture separating the public entry point, application layer and database.
points: Application Load Balancer provides the application entry point.
EC2 application instances run in private subnets.
RDS database is isolated from direct public access.

projects.name: Event-driven image converter
projects.description: An automated pipeline that converts uploaded JPG images into PNG files.
points: Uploading a JPG to the source bucket invokes Lambda.
Python and Pillow process the image using a Lambda layer.
The resulting PNG is written to a separate destination bucket.

projects.name: Serverless Task Manager
projects.description: A task management project designed around sandbox-compatible AWS services.
points: Designed registration, login, sessions and task CRUD flows.
Used Lambda Function URLs where API Gateway was unavailable.
Explored CloudFormation automation and rotating sandbox credentials.

projects.name: Image analysis pipeline
projects.description: Browser-based image upload and analysis using AWS managed services.
points: Browser upload flow uses presigned S3 URLs.
Rekognition provides image analysis, supported by a Lambda backend.
Worked through Function URL CORS configuration and project integration.

projects.name: FlowGenic automation

projects.description: A planned subscription platform connecting QR ordering, kitchen operations and reception billing.

Planned subscription tiers and the product scope.

projects.name: Clinic EMR & billing
projects.description: A clinic workflow concept joining patient records, medicine dispensing and billing.
points: Mapped doctor entry of patient details and treatment information.
Defined staff medicine dispensing and bill printing.
Prepared requirements and assumptions for implementation.

projects.name: AWS Foundations sessions
projects.description: An interactive introduction helping students connect cloud concepts with live AWS demonstrations.
points: Delivered interactive cloud foundation sessions with practical demonstrations.
Demonstrated static website hosting on Amazon S3 and other AWS services.
Used practical examples to make cloud concepts easier to understand.
